CustomField.description: NPP reason code for the case.
CustomField.formula: IF(RecordType.DeveloperName = "NPP_Dispute" && ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Incorrect Amount Transferred"), "DUPL", IF(RecordType.DeveloperName = "NPP_Dispute" && ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Incorrect Account Details"), "CUST", IF(RecordType.DeveloperName = "NPP_Dispute" && ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Duplicate Transaction"), "DUPL", IF(RecordType.DeveloperName = "NPP_Dispute" && ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Return money received from an unknown person"), "MD06",""))))
CustomField.label: Reason Code
